bull_bear.body:
- We depend on a limited number of customers for a significant portion of our revenues.
- The loss of a major customer or significant reduction in demand from any of our major customers may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and profitability.
- A significant portion of our revenue is derived from a limited number of customers, primarily large solar developers, EPC contractors and O&M service providers.
- Our dependence on a concentrated customer base exposes us to revenue volatility and business uncertainty.
- If any of our major customers reduces their procurement of our robotic cleaning systems, delays ongoing projects, negotiates lower prices, or terminates contracts, our business and financial performance may be adversely affected.
- Further, due to the niche nature of the solar robotics industry, large customers often have higher bargaining power.
- However, we confirm that during the last three financial years, we have not experienced any disruption, material dispute, cancellation, or adverse impact on our business arising from customer concentration or loss of a major customer.
- Periods of high rainfall or lower dust accumulation typically reduce the frequency of panel cleaning, which may temporarily decrease demand for cleaning services or delay deployment schedules by customers.
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Headquartered in Bengaluru, Karnataka, we operate two modern manufacturing facilities equipped for the design, assembly, and testing of autonomous and semi-autonomous robotic systems. We offer a comprehensive portfolio of robotic solutions designed to automate and optimize solar power plant operations. In the field of module cleaning, we offer two flagship products — Unicorn and Shreem — fully autonomous robots designed for ground-mounted and rooftop installations, respectively.

risks: We depend on a limited number of customers for a significant portion of our revenues.
The loss of a major customer or significant reduction in demand from any of our major customers may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and profitability.
A significant portion of our revenue is derived from a limited number of customers, primarily large solar developers, EPC contractors and O&M service providers.
Our dependence on a concentrated customer base exposes us to revenue volatility and business uncertainty.

If any of our major customers reduces their procurement of our robotic cleaning systems, delays ongoing projects, negotiates lower prices, or terminates contracts, our business and financial performance may be adversely affected.
Further, due to the niche nature of the solar robotics industry, large customers often have higher bargaining power.

However, we confirm that during the last three financial years, we have not experienced any disruption, material dispute, cancellation, or adverse impact on our business arising from customer concentration or loss of a major customer.

Periods of high rainfall or lower dust accumulation typically reduce the frequency of panel cleaning, which may temporarily decrease demand for cleaning services or delay deployment schedules by customers.

financial_valuation.risk: If any one or more of the following risks as well as other risks and uncertainties discussed in the Red Herring Prospectus were to occur, our business, financial condition and results of our operation could suffer material adverse effects, and could cause the trading price of our Equity Shares and the value of investment in the Equity Shares to materially decline which could result in the loss of all or part of investment.

Unpredictable Soiling Patterns, Seasonal Variations and Extreme Weather Events Could Materially and Adversely Affect Our Business, Financial Condition, Results of Operations and Cash Flows The demand for our robotic cleaning systems, Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC), and Module Cleaning as a Service (MCaaS) is significantly influenced by the soiling intensity on solar modules, which varies across regions and seasons.

Any delay in the adoption of robotic cleaning solutions, resistance from potential customers, or slower-thanexpected industry maturity could adversely affect our market penetration, revenue growth, predictability of cash flows, and long-term scalability.

risks.title: Bear — key risks
risks.body:
- We depend on a limited number of customers for a significant portion of our revenues.
- The loss of a major customer or significant reduction in demand from any of our major customers may adversely affect our business, financial condition, results of operations and profitability.
- A significant portion of our revenue is derived from a limited number of customers, primarily large solar developers, EPC contractors and O&M service providers.
- Our dependence on a concentrated customer base exposes us to revenue volatility and business uncertainty.
- If any of our major customers reduces their procurement of our robotic cleaning systems, delays ongoing projects, negotiates lower prices, or terminates contracts, our business and financial performance may be adversely affected.
- Further, due to the niche nature of the solar robotics industry, large customers often have higher bargaining power.
- However, we confirm that during the last three financial years, we have not experienced any disruption, material dispute, cancellation, or adverse impact on our business arising from customer concentration or loss of a major customer.
- Periods of high rainfall or lower dust accumulation typically reduce the frequency of panel cleaning, which may temporarily decrease demand for cleaning services or delay deployment schedules by customers.
